description.value: Echo Landing is the newest ski-in, ski-out property at Sun Peaks Resort, positioned between the 15th fairway of BC's highest-elevation golf course and the Orient chairlift. The development offers contemporary 2- to 4-bedroom townhomes and condos with full kitchens, and select units include private hot tubs. It sits in the quieter east village, just a short walk from the main village and directly adjacent to Sun Peaks' extensive mountain-bike trail network.
